name: rcpl-vendor-pod-management
description: RCPL Vendor POD Management System — Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Storage, Functions, Hosting)

scripts.emulators: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-rcpl-pod --export-on-exit=./.emulator-data
scripts.build: npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w functions && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-rcpl-pod --only auth,firestore,storage,functions "npm run test:all -w functions"
scripts.emulators:resume: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-rcpl-pod --import=./.emulator-data --export-on-exit=./.emulator-data
